verdict.rationale: Reducto is not itself an agent but a document-processing API/platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a valid axis; docs explicitly describe an official MCP server enabling agents in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, and other MCP clients to parse/extract/split/classify/edit documents, and a runtime probe confirms a live hosted MCP endpoint at mcp.reducto.ai/mcp completing a proper auth handshake plus a docs MCP completing a full initialize handshake. missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) hands-on report of using the MCP server in a real agent workflow.
